svg.title: Enterprise Agent Factory AWS service-level reference architecture
svg.desc: AWS reference implementation showing Management, Security, Observability, Platform, and repeatable Workstream accounts; the AWS services mapped to each capability; and numbered software delivery, identity, inference, tool, and telemetry flows.
svg.text: Enterprise Agent Factory on AWS — service-level reference architecture
Multi-account landing zone · Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Workstream cells · shared governed inference · one release contract
Agent Factory platform account — control plane
Golden paths, governance catalog and shared inference · consumed through versioned interfaces, not deployment tickets
Workstream cell account — product / domain A
One of N repeatable cells · independent release & failure boundary
Call path — one governed release and run cycle
Golden-path pipeline builds, evaluates and signs the agent (CodePipeline · CodeBuild)
Versioned release pulled from Amazon ECR / CodeArtifact into the cell — one release contract
Agent registered in the governance catalog with owner, tools and lifecycle state
AgentCore Runtime executes sessions · Memory persists short/long-term state
Runtime obtains workload identity — AgentCore Identity + Amazon Cognito M2M tokens
Inference travels over AWS PrivateLink to allow-listed Bedrock models behind Guardrails
Tool calls pass AgentCore Gateway — IAM + Verified Permissions approve exact aliases
Logs, metrics, traces and cost flow via CloudWatch OAM to the observability account
Account IDs are placeholders · logical reference architecture · official AWS Architecture Icons
